p1ToP8RemainFailClosed.P2: at least 3 consecutive robots refusals, or more than 40 percent of the five-item window; count threshold 3
p1ToP8RemainFailClosed.P3: at least 2 consecutive FAILED, or any ORCHESTRATION_ERROR

p1ToP8RemainFailClosed.P6: reserveConsumed above 10 AND canonical successes below 50; because no reserve is consumed here, reserveConsumed must remain 10
p1ToP8RemainFailClosed.onAnyPause: STOP THE ENTIRE CADENCE. Do not merely start the next five-item child window
